title: Animation.optimize discards important keyframe in ValueTrack
body:
### Tested versions


Discovered in 4.8 dev build 00932449c9f372b30301d8b5fdc1be70ec12b5c0, but reproduced on 4.4 as well.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (d0f83fb2e) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) A750 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6790) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400F (12 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory - WASAPI (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7428a458-f75f-4183-9932-bf0c2d197971

Animation.optimize appears to be discarding the second keyframe of looping animations, even if that keyframe is significant.  I would expect it to discard keyframes which have little to no impact on the described motion, but this is not the case here.

Does not appear to be specific to track type or invocation method; also observed with 3D position tracks where optimization was invoked by a tool script.

### Steps to reproduce

Load the scene below.
Click "2D" at the top to enter 2D mode.
Click on the "AnimationPlayer" node in the Scene tab in the top left corner.
Click the Play button in the top left corner of the "Animation" tab at the bottom.
Note that the sprite moves in a square loop.
From the "Edit" button in the top right corner of the "Animation" tab, select "Optimize Animation (no undo)".
Click "Optimize".
Note that the sprite now moves in a triangle loop and that the second keyframe has been deleted.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://dob6gkr26gh2y"]

[sub_resource type="PlaceholderTexture2D" id="PlaceholderTexture2D_1w5cm"]
size = Vector2(4, 4)

[sub_resource type="Animation" id="Animation_r6lny"]
resource_name = "new_animation"
loop_mode = 1
step = 0.25
tracks/0/type = "value"
tracks/0/imported = false
tracks/0/enabled = true
tracks/0/path = NodePath("Sprite2D:position")
tracks/0/interp = 1
tracks/0/loop_wrap = true
tracks/0/keys = {
"times": PackedFloat32Array(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
"transitions": PackedFloat32Array(1, 1, 1, 1),
"update": 0,
"values": [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(0, 4), Vector2(4, 4), Vector2(4, 0)]
}

[sub_resource type="AnimationLibrary" id="AnimationLibrary_m2i5v"]
_data = {
&"new_animation": SubResource("Animation_r6lny")
}

[node name="Unoptimized" type="Node2D" unique_id=1066170131]

[node name="Sprite2D" type="Sprite2D" parent="." unique_id=954630656]
texture = SubResource("PlaceholderTexture2D_1w5cm")

[node name="AnimationPlayer" type="AnimationPlayer" parent="." unique_id=1167504211]
libraries/ = SubResource("AnimationLibrary_m2i5v")
autoplay = &"new_animation"
```
